per_item.question: List the names of all students.
How many students are there?

per_item.question: What is the average GPA of all students?
per_item.pred_sql: SELECT AVG(gpa) AS average_gpa FROM students

per_item.question: List the names of students with a GPA above 3.5.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa > 3.5;

per_item.question: How many students are in each department? Show the department name and the count.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(s.student_id) FROM departments d LEFT JOIN students s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id;
per_item.pred_sql:
SELECT d.name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS student_count
FROM departments d
JOIN students s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id
GROUP BY d.name;

per_item.question: Which department has the highest budget? Return its name.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM departments ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1;
per_item.pred_sql: SELECT name FROM departments WHERE budget = (SELECT MAX(budget) FROM departments);

per_item.question: How many courses is each student enrolled in? Show student name and count.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(e.course_id) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id;
per_item.pred_sql:
SELECT s.name, COUNT(e.course_id) AS course_count
FROM students s
JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.name

per_item.question: List the names of departments that have more than 2 students.

SELECT d.name

per_item.question: How many students enrolled in each year? Show the year and the count.

per_item.question: Which student has taken the most courses? Return their name.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id ORDER BY COUNT(e.course_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
